text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      DOTNET_ROOT: ${{ steps.set-dotnet-root.outputs.dotnet-root }}
      PATH: ${{ steps.set-path.outputs.path }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 9
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: 9.x
          dotnet-quality: stable
          dotnet-channel: stable
          architecture: x64

      - name: Set DOTNET_ROOT output
        id: set-dotnet-root
        run: echo "dotnet-root=$HOME/.dotnet" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set PATH output
        id: set-path
        run: echo "path=$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build all projects
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release
```
